run_paddleocr_vl_conditional_generation: run PaddleOCR-VL for conditional text generation from image and text inputs
get_paddleocr_vl_image_features: get image features from PaddleOCR-VL vision encoder and projector for a given pixel tensor
compute_paddleocr_vl_rope_index: compute the 3D multimodal RoPE position index for mixed image-text input sequences
build_paddleocr_vl_language_model: build the PaddleOCR-VL text decoder language model with rotary embeddings and causal attention
run_paddleocr_vl_vision_transformer: run the PaddleOCR-VL vision transformer to extract visual embeddings from pixel values
